question: Article 26 of the Indian constitution is related to which of the following?

options.text: Freedom as to payment of taxes for promotion of any particular religion

solution:
The correct answer is Freedom to manage religious affairs.

 
• There are six fundamental rights provided in the Constitution of India. Part III and Article 12 – 35 deal with fundamental rights in the Constitution of India.
 
• Right to freedom of religion - Articles 25-28 
 
• The right to freedom of religion finds its mention under Articles 25-28.
 
• Article 25 refers to the freedom of conscience and free profession, practice, and propagation of religion.
 
• Article 26 refers to the freedom to manage religious affairs.
